item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens: The status line 'since about…
item.description: The status line 'since about Aug 2018' came from an SF Chronicle piece that said Parklab Gardens was 'opening Friday', a report written before the opening. An opening needs a source written after it. The line now rests on Hoodline's report, published August 20, 2018, that Stagecoach Greens, which OCII's November 2024 legend places on P15, 'is now open'. The month stays approximate because that report gives no opening day. No source written after the opening was found for Parklab Gardens, so it has no opening date here. Source: Hoodline, "Now open in Mission Bay: SF's first outdoor mini-golf course" (Aug 20, 2018, https://hoodline.com/2018/08/now-open-in-mission-bay-sf-s-first-outdoor-mini-golf-course/): "San Francisco’s first outdoor mini-golf course, Stagecoach Greens, is now open at 1379 4th St. in Mission Bay."; OCII, Mission Bay Future Parks CAC Update, Nov 14, 2024 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf), PDF p.17 legend: "P15 Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens".
item.source: Hoodline, "Now open in Mission Bay: SF's first outdoor mini-golf course" (Aug 20, 2018, https://hoodline.com/2018/08/now-open-in-mission-bay-sf-s-first-outdoor-mini-golf-course/): "San Francisco’s first outdoor mini-golf course, Stagecoach Greens, is now open at 1379 4th St. in Mission Bay."; OCII, Mission Bay Future Parks CAC Update, Nov 14, 2024 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/2024-11/Item%205%20-%20Remaining%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Parcels%20Update.pdf), PDF p.17 legend: "P15 Parklab Gardens & Stagecoach Greens"

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Commons P15: Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens: The one record for the three…
item.description: The one record for the three west Commons parcels is now three, one per parcel, each named for its parcel and the uses OCII's November 2024 update lists on it. This record keeps its address history and now covers parcel P15 (Parklab Gardens and Stagecoach Greens) only, between 4th St and 3rd St. Its shape was the whole Parklab park strip from OpenStreetMap; it is now that strip's P15 part, cut at 4th St along DataSF's street centerline plus 6.8 m, and is marked approximate because the parcel lines are drawn from OCII's drawing, not surveyed. item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 13: Block 13's new 93 ft and 133 ft limits do not apply yet
item.description: Block 13's new 93 ft and 133 ft limits do not apply yet. The block is in the PG&E Sub-Area, where the ordinance takes effect only after a Notice of Joinder to the Development Agreement is recorded or the land is conveyed to the Developer. We found no sign that either has happened. The same condition applied to the earlier 85 ft and 125 ft limits, so they have not been in force on this land either. The earlier note giving November 13, 2026 for Block 13 was wrong. Source: BOS File 260770 'Leg Final' attachment, pp. 52, 54, 56; BOS File 260724 'Leg Final' attachment, pp. 2 and 10; SF Planning, Potrero Power Station project page (read 2026-10-18).

item.title: Correction · Potrero Power Station Block 14: Block 14's page said the block is inside PG&E's…

The ordinance enacted in October 2026 redrew that area: its new map puts the PG&E Sub-Area west of Georgia Street and Block 14 outside it, where the 2020 design document had treated the block as part of the area. Only the new 98 ft limit, from November 13, 2026, applies; the 2020 design's 90 ft label never took effect there. This outline is the union of lots 8723003, 8723004 and 8723006, so it is parcel P26, and a photo caption on OCII's Mission Bay South open-space page reads "P26 Mariposa Park". The page is renamed Mariposa Park (it was labelled P27) and the old address redirects. The shape, status and use are unchanged. Source: Successor Agency to the San Francisco Redevelopment Agency, Mission Bay North and South Long-Range Property Management Plan, Attachment A, page 11 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf), row 32 "Park P26 | North side of Mariposa between Owens and 4th Streets | 8723-003, 004, 006, 007(p) | 87,556" and row 33 "Park P27 | Northwest corner of Owens and Mariposa Streets | 8723-002 | 15,246"; OCII, Mission Bay South: Open Space (https://sfocii.org/projects/mission-bay-south/open-space), photo caption: "P26 Mariposa Park".

item.title: Correction · Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P27: About 86% of this outline lies inside Assessor lot…
item.description: About 86% of this outline lies inside Assessor lot 8723002, the lot OCII's plan gives Park P27, at the northwest corner of Owens and Mariposa Streets. The page is renamed Mission Bay Open Space Parcel P27 (it was labelled P26) and the old address redirects. It is now shown as planned, not complete: OCII's September 2023 transition presentation lists P27 among the parcels Rec and Park will manage "when built", and no source read says it was built. The outline is unchanged; it covers 61% of the lot, so the lot's own lines are not used. Source: Successor Agency to the San Francisco Redevelopment Agency, Mission Bay North and South Long-Range Property Management Plan, Attachment A, page 11 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/02%20Mission%20Bay.pdf), row 32 "Park P26 | North side of Mariposa between Owens and 4th Streets | 8723-003, 004, 006, 007(p) | 87,556" and row 33 "Park P27 | Northwest corner of Owens and Mariposa Streets | 8723-002 | 15,246"; OCII, Mission Bay Open Space Transition presentation, September 2023, slide 5 (https://sfocii.org/sites/default/files/inline-files/Item%202%20Mission%20Bay%20Open%20Space%20Transition.pdf): "RPD will manage NP1-NP5; P1, P2 Parking Lot Landscaping, P3, P5, P6, P10, P11/11A, P16, P17 & P26 (Plus P2/P8, P7, P9, P12, P13, P15 and P27 when built)".
